name: HENACHEL_GOAL_OPERATIONAL_V1
cutoff: FINAL/OFF regular season or playoff games with NHL date_match strictly less than target NHL date D; current-day outcomes excluded before validation or feature selection
split: Unique eligible dates sorted; first floor(0.85*N) dates fit; remaining dates calibration; minimum 20 dates
training: HGB; positive weight n_negative/n_positive; variable usable columns selected using fit partition only; missing values remain NaN
calibration: Existing auto selector: raw/sigmoid(logit clipped 1e-6,C=1e6)/isotonic. Fit on first half of calibration dates; rank on later half by log loss then Brier then raw/sigmoid/isotonic order; refit selected method on full calibration window. Existing single-class/insufficient-date raw fallback unchanged.
weights: Refitted daily; algorithm frozen, not fitted weights
